title: WATCH: Hamas publishes footage from hostage release showing tunnels where hostages were held - Geller Report
text:
Watch the horrific and inhumane conditions the Israeli hostages are living in under Hamas captivity. A crime against humanity by any standard. Hamas needs to be wiped off the face of the earth.
I feel physically sick posting this—but we must do everything in our power to spread the truth as far and wide as possible.
This is Hamas.
This is how they treat their hostages. For 491 days and counting, they’ve held them in captivity after slaughtering many of their family… pic.twitter.com/BIUGZXc8M3
— Eitan Fischberger (@EFischberger) February 8, 2025
Revolting doesn’t even begin to describe. Biden and Co. knew this was the case and kept sending aid….to the enemy. Evil. https://t.co/esXl0IKHpD
— Katie Pavlich (@KatiePavlich) February 8, 2025
Barbarians parading starved slaves. pic.twitter.com/JvMjGKaJO8
— Marina Medvin 🇺🇸 (@MarinaMedvin) February 8, 2025
It is beyond dispute that US taxpayers helped pay for these terror tunnels.
Also worth noting that while others may have faced distribution issues in some parts of Gaza, Hamas had access to almost unlimited aid. Starving the hostages was a choice. https://t.co/tQ7uUYnzvc
— AG (@AGHamilton29) February 8, 2025
WATCH: Hamas publishes footage from hostage release showing tunnels where hostages were held
By World Israel News , Feb 8th, 2025
Hamas released a propaganda video showing the transfer of three Israeli hostages Or Levy, Eli Sharabi, and Ohad Ben Ami from Gaza terror tunnels to Red Cross officials.
